note: Rusk County, WI publishes zoning only as file geodatabase zip downloads (GeoData@Wisconsin 2025 and 2016 RUSK_ZONING_2025.zip / Rusk_Zoning_2016.zip, ESRI gdb not a queryable service) and static PDF zoning maps (county comprehensive zoning map; City of Ladysmith zoning map PDF). No ArcGIS REST zoning service found in county, city, GeoData@Wisconsin, or ArcGIS Online/Hub searches. The county's Beacon viewer is parcel-only. Nine townships have comprehensive zoning per county site.
